commit 3b12470e54413c1998eefd9e8e21b91ec3454183
Author:     Rob Lemley <rob@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Tue Mar 25 14:11:55 2025 +0000
Commit:     Rob Lemley <rob@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Tue Mar 25 14:11:55 2025 +0000

    Bug 1951918 - Remove --disable-thunderbird-rust option. r=dandarnell
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D242050

diff --git a/mail/moz.configure b/mail/moz.configure
index b1afc03a2c0..ad923904f58 100644
--- a/mail/moz.configure
+++ b/mail/moz.configure
@@ -169,26 +169,13 @@ imply_option(
     reason=thunderbird_official_branding,
 )
 
-# Thunderbird Rust code is now the default
-option("--disable-thunderbird-rust", help="Enable Rust support within Thunderbird")
-
-set_config("MOZ_THUNDERBIRD_RUST", True, when="--enable-thunderbird-rust")
-set_define("MOZ_THUNDERBIRD_RUST", True, when="--enable-thunderbird-rust")
-set_config("MOZ_OVERRIDE_GKRUST", True, when="--enable-thunderbird-rust")
-
-
-@depends("--enable-thunderbird-rust")
-def moz_override_cargo_config(enable_rust):
-    rust_override = "comm/rust/.cargo/config.toml.in"
-    if enable_rust:
-        log.info(f"Using {rust_override} for Rust code.")
-        return rust_override
-
-
+# Thunderbird Rust code is now the only way to compile
+set_config("MOZ_THUNDERBIRD_RUST", True)
+set_define("MOZ_THUNDERBIRD_RUST", True)
+set_config("MOZ_OVERRIDE_GKRUST", True)
 set_config(
     "MOZ_OVERRIDE_CARGO_CONFIG",
-    moz_override_cargo_config,
-    when="--enable-thunderbird-rust",
+    "comm/rust/.cargo/config.toml.in",
 )
 
 # Build with (but not necessarily use) the new database.
title: Bug 1951918 - Remove --disable-thunderbird-rust option. r=dandarnell
